subject: Logic
title: Thinking in Payoff Matrices
description: A micro-lesson that makes Thinking in Payoff Matrices usable.

hook.text: Should you confess or stay silent? The answer changes depending on what your partner does. Welcome to strategy.

buildup.text: A payoff matrix maps every combination of your choices and your opponent's choices with resulting outcomes.

discovery.text: Reading the matrix reveals dominant strategies—moves that are best regardless of what the other side does.

twist.text: Sometimes no dominant strategy exists. Then your best move depends entirely on predicting the other player.

climax.text: Payoff matrices turn messy real-world conflicts into structured problems you can analyze logically.

punchline.text: Map the options. The strategy reveals itself.

quiz.question: What does a payoff matrix show?
options: Outcomes for every combination of players' choices
